card.name: "Until now" in news and science stories
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "until" right before "now" in sentences like "But until now, we haven't...". Also fires on a few words in time spans ("thirty years since", "any time soon") in general web news and science writing.

card.writes: It pushes toward time-span continuations such as "since last year" or "from last year" and away from "today" words.
card.plain: It marks phrases about time in news and science writing, mainly "until now", where the next words are about the past rather than today.
